text:
maya: FYI spotted weird quality drift on Mixtral-1.2 in the nightly perf sweep.
sok: which metric/eval? short or long context?
maya: long-context summarization evals (8k+). failure rate up ~6% on our regression set. p95 latency also +12% on tiled-attn selector.
liam: did we flip any kernel selector rules last night? I saw a rollout for 'attn-tiering' around 02:10.
maya: yes, attn-tiering was rolled to prefer tiled_attn_v2 for sequence_length>=2048. deploy-bot: rollout attn-tiering started by liam at 2026-03-24T02:10Z (canary 10%).
eva: logs show an attention kernel swap + a kv layout change in the same window. suspect RoPE scaling mismatch with tiled_attn_v2 + new kv packing.
sok: that combination could shift head alignment if kv dims or head ordering changed. did the model conversion script reorder heads for Mixtral variants?
liam: conversion pipeline had a small refactor: we switched kv layout to [heads, dim/head, seq] for cache friendliness. Patch: \n```
conv.py: pack_kv(layout='packed_heads')
```
I thought it was no-op for runtime but maybe tiled_attn_v2 expects interleaved layout.
maya: repro on local: golden output vs runtime shows token shift starting at token 2049. attention maps look similar but scaled incorrectly — consistent with RoPE phase offset.
sok: RoPE scaling change + layout swap can cause phase to be applied to wrong axis. Did we touch RoPE scale factor in model config? mixtral-configs repo shows scale override toggled to 0.98 for long context experiments.
liam: right, I pushed a quantization toggle too (int8_fast path) in the same PR to reduce memory. Could be multi-factor.
eva: profiling: attached snapshot (summarized) — tiled_attn_v2 p99 kernel time down 20ms, but kv-copy overhead + re-layout added 28ms. net reg on latency. Quality: logits drift at top-3 for many prompts.
maya: local eval diff: \n- baseline tiled_attn_v1 + packed_kv=false + fp16 + rope_scale=1.0 => pass
- current tiled_attn_v2 + packed_kv=true + int8_fast + rope_scale=0.98 => fail
We need to isolate which toggle causes the quality regression.
sok: plan: A/B toggles. 1) revert kv packing only, keep tiled_attn_v2 + int8_fast + rope_scale=0.98; 2) revert rope_scale only; 3) disable int8_fast path. run quick eval 100-case long-context set.
liam: I'll push quick canary flags so runtime can serve variants by selector tags. config keys: \n```json
{"kernel_variant": "tiled_attn_v2","kv_packed": true,"quant_path": "int8_fast","rope_scale": 0.98}
```
maya: can we shadow-serve golden outputs for the same requests so we capture token-level diffs? need per-token alignment.
eva: yes, shadowing enabled. also adding a tracer to capture attention weights + kv shapes.
deploy-bot: canary flags applied to 5% traffic for config variants by liam at 2026-03-24T03:05Z.
sok: early results: reverting rope_scale to 1.0 recovers quality but latency still off. that points rope_scale as primary quality factor.
liam: surprising — rope_scale was intended as a tiny tweak. maybe Mixtral's RoPE paramization assumes interleaved head layout. If layout differs, effective phase becomes scaled differently.
maya: for rollback decision: we should immediately revert attn-tiering rollout (stop favoring tiled_attn_v2) and pin rope_scale to 1.0 across Mixtral variants. Keep int8_fast off until we understand.
sok: agree. I'll open a rollback PR and a follow-up investigation ticket to test head ordering + rope interactions across kernels.
eva: also let's add a unit test that runs a tiny long-context prompt through all kernel+kv_layout combos and checks top-5 logits don't shift by >1e-3.
liam: PR #4392 created to pin kernel selector to tiled_attn_v1 for Mixtral and reset rope_scale. rolling back canary now.
deploy-bot: rollback of attn-tiering canary executed by liam at 2026-03-24T03:22Z. Canary now 0%.
maya: good. postmortem notes: concurrent changes (kv packing + rope_scale + quant path + kernel swap) in one rollout made root cause hard to find. next time, single-variable rollouts.
sok: adding checklist to runtime rollouts: (1) single-flag toggles, (2) short+long evals auto-run, (3) shadow diffs on canary. I'll draft and share.
maya: thanks everyone. follow-up: assign triage to eng-ml for model conversion audit and eng-runtime for kernel selector tests.
